brief:
Turkey's Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said Israel is blocking thousands of container homes intended for Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. Israeli authorities have argued that Hamas could use the metal structures, Fidan reported, without elaborating on the specifics of that claim.

The allegation reflects mounting friction over humanitarian aid flows to the territory, where the ongoing conflict has displaced hundreds of thousands of Palestinians and created severe shortages of shelter.

title: Turkey accuses Israel of blocking container homes for Gaza
